prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
competitors_mentioned: Board Certification in Personal Injury Trial Law
answer_verbatim:
I can’t definitively name a single “best” lawyer — that depends on your case facts and what matters most to you (trial experience, settlements/verdicts, communication style, fees). I can, however, tell you exactly how to find and evaluate the top personal injury lawyers in Dallas who handle truck accidents, and help you get a short list that fits your needs.

Key qualifications to look for
- Proven truck-accident experience (not just general PI). Truck cases involve federal regs (FMCSA), ELD/black box data, driver logs, carrier safety records and often complex liability issues.  
- Board certification in Personal Injury Trial Law (Texas Board of Legal Specialization) is a strong plus.  
- Substantial verdicts/settlements in truck cases and trial experience (many carriers/insurers only take claims seriously if the lawyer will try the case).  
- Resources to investigate and fund the case (accident reconstructionists, medical experts, stimulus to obtain carrier records).  
- Good reviews and peer recognition (Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell AV Preeminent, The National Trial Lawyers, client testimonials).  
- Clean disciplinary record with the State Bar of Texas.

What to ask in a free consultation
- How many truck accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?  
- Have you handled cases against the same carrier or insurer involved in my crash?  
- What were the typical results (settlement range, verdicts)?  
- Who will actually handle my case (attorney or paralegal)?  
- Do you work on contingency? What percentage and what costs are advanced/recouped?  
- What is your communication style/frequency? Who will be my point of contact?  
- How long do you expect my case to take?  
- Can you get ELD/black box data, driver logs and the carrier’s safety rating?

Red flags
- Reluctance to explain fee structure or who handles the work.  
- No written retainer or unclear fee/cost arrangements.  
- Promises of a specific result or overly pushy advertising.  
- Little or no experience with commercial truck cases.

Where to search and verify credentials
- State Bar of Texas (attorney search and disciplinary history)  
- Texas Board of Legal Specialization (board-certified attorneys)  
- Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo (ratings and peer reviews)  
- Local trial lawyer associations and trucking-focused groups

Next steps I can help with
- Provide a short vetted list of Dallas truck-accident lawyers (I can pull names and recent ratings if you want).  
- Draft a short list of questions tailored to your case to use in consultations.  
- Explain what evidence you should preserve now (photos, medical records, police report, witnesses) and what to request from the carrier.

If you want, tell me your ZIP code or the area of Dallas you’re in and whether you prefer large firms or smaller boutique trial shops — I’ll build a short list of attorneys/firms with quick notes on their experience and ratings.
